text: Found something on Explore that fits your production? Add it straight to the project as a reference.
On the project, references sit together, so the whole team works from the same picture.
Paste an Instagram post or reel, and Nia reads it into a reference too.
And Nia suggests more, matched to the project's type, genres, deliverables and description.
Beside them sit the production details: shoot dates, client, agency, deliverables, the due date and the budget, which only you and your editors can see.
Fill them in as the production takes shape. They save as you go.
